preconditions.description: The victim (token owner) must have a sufficient balance of BNRG tokens to approve and transfer
Contract state must be Unlocked or Restricted (not Locked) to allow transfers from non-owner addresses

exploit_hint: The approve function is vulnerable to a race condition where an attacker can front-run a victim's approval transaction. 1) Monitor for a victim's approve transaction with amount X. 2) Front-run it with a transferFrom call using an existing allowance Y (where Y < X). 3) The victim's approve transaction then sets allowance to X, overwriting the reduced allowance. 4) Attacker can now transfer both Y and X amounts, effectively getting Y+X tokens instead of just X.
